Xenoblade Chronicles 3 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition – Overview Trailer
Xenoblade Chronicles 3 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition will be available on December 3, 2026. Pre-orders are available now on Nintendo eShop: https://ninten.do/6000xBoqG

Experience the epic tale of life and interconnected futures, now enhanced for the Nintendo Switch 2 system! The Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of this game features improved visuals, sharper cutscenes, the new mode Heroes' Vault, and more. Plus, meet the new Hero, Shimmer, and wield her Foresight ability.

Nintendo Switch 2 players who already have Xenoblade Chronicles 3 on Nintendo Switch can upgrade to the Nintendo Switch 2 Edition by purchasing the upgrade pack.

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s

Mario Kart World – Ver. 1.9.0 Update Available Now – Nintendo Switch 2
A free update is available now in the Mario Kart World game, only on Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/mario-kart-world-switch-2/ 

Eight familiar courses are racing in, each with brand-new twists and turns! Plus, enjoy two new routes in Knockout Tour, and watch replays of past races and battles with the newly enhanced Replay feature.
